title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Our first meal in Istanbul was the the döner kebab at Dürümzade (in Beyoglu) and it’s a core memory from our travels. If there’s one must-try meal in Istanbul, it’s this one.

Other restaurants we explored in Istanbul were Karakoy Sarihan Iskembe for breakfast, Istanbul Anatolian Cuisine and Hanzade Bosphorus Restaurant for lunch, and a lovely Armenian joint called Jash for dinner.
And of course, we indulged in lots and lots of baklava from small shops in the tourist areas.
